description:
Programme Overview

The KAUST Global Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers attracts and supports outstanding emerging research leaders from around the world, empowering them to build a path towards a fully independent career. The program inspires the next generation of scientists and engineers to address global challenges and create opportunities that benefit humanity. This merit-based program targets excellent postdoctoral researchers with breakthrough ideas that can complement, support, and advance the major research priorities of KAUST.

Research Areas

The KAUST Global Fellowship identifies exceptional early-career scientists with the independence, ambition and ideas to address the world's most pressing global challenges in:

  • Water
  • Food
  • Energy
  • Health
  • AI
  • Marine Science (with focus on the Red Sea)

What the Fellowship Provides

  • Top-tier international faculty: A KAUST host PI with similar research interests will mentor, empower and support you to successfully conduct your independent research.
  • Fellow-led research: As a Global Fellow you will design and lead your own original research at KAUST, advancing knowledge, opening new pathways for innovation, and contributing to the KAUST research missions.
  • Unparalleled research facilities: Direct access to multidisciplinary laboratories located on campus equipped with cutting-edge technologies and staffed with experts to support faculty, students, researchers, and partners.
  • In our 'research-first' environment, Global Fellows have full access to world-class research tools and equipment, unparalleled facilities, and expertise required to realise their research ambitions.

Application Process (Two-Stage)

Stage 1 (Concept Note)

  • Accepting applications: 1 September – 1 October
  • Applicants submit a concept note outlining their research idea.

Stage 2 (Full Proposal, by invitation)

  • Accepting applications: 15 November – 15 January
  • Selected applicants are invited to submit a full proposal.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to outstanding postdoctoral researchers from around the world.
  • Must have a PhD or equivalent.
  • Must have breakthrough ideas that align with KAUST's research priorities.
  • No nationality restrictions.

Application dates

4700 King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
Thuwal 23955-6900
Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

Important Notes

  • KAUST is officially recognised as the most acclaimed postgraduate research university in the Middle East.
  • Founded in 2009, KAUST has established itself as Saudi Arabia's most collaborative and innovative university.
  • The program is merit-based and supports early-career researchers.
  • Fellows have full access to world-class research tools and facilities.
